purpose: Pin the exact source bytes for an effects-disabled aggregate synthetic evaluator and its independent output verifier.
claim_ceiling: Source blob pinning detects unreviewed byte drift only; it is not a signature or source-authenticity proof.
Rust tests verify selected implementation invariants only.
The independent verifier validates artifact structure and specific cross-scenario relationships only.
No causal crime-reduction effect, model calibration, real-world validity, robot safety qualification, or jurisdictional generalization is established.
All outcome-generating parameters have explicit synthetic-assumption labels; no parameter in the register is an empirically estimated local coefficient.
The zero-quality-work-effect scenario tests behavior when the assumed work effect is disabled; neither setting is an empirical effect estimate.

parameter_registry.limitation: Defines simulation size and observation window only; not a claim about any real community.
Cohorts are anonymous aggregate cells with no person records or inferred individual attributes.
Illustrative starting conditions, not local housing, food, utilities, or benefits-access measurements.
The rates are not estimates of actual crime, violence, victimization, or offending.
These multipliers are illustrative heterogeneity controls, not proof that socioeconomic status or group membership predicts individual behavior.

parameter_registry.unit: fractional-access gain before bounded access calculation
parameter_registry.limitation: Assumed programme effects, not a forecast of real service uptake or delivered access.

parameter_registry.unit: fractional reduction in modeled event probability
parameter_registry.limitation: Fixed toy-model elasticities are not estimated from NIJ or review evidence and are not transferable effect sizes. A zero-effect scenario is included as a null sensitivity control; no local or universal effect is established.

parameter_registry.unit: modeled probability per eligible property-event opportunity
parameter_registry.limitation: Not a tested robot success rate. The low-effectiveness case tests monotonic sensitivity only.

parameter_registry.unit: probability that a simulated harm event is marked reported
parameter_registry.limitation: Not a real reporting rate. This parameter exists specifically to demonstrate that reports and underlying harm differ.

parameter_registry.unit: probability that a modeled prevented local property event reappears in the adjacent ring
parameter_registry.limitation: The adjacent ring is represented by an aggregate counter, not a spatial network or geographic forecast.

parameter_registry.unit: probability of one modeled system compromise per week
parameter_registry.limitation: Not a vulnerability rate, threat forecast, or robot reliability statistic.
Not human-safety, false-positive, or cybersecurity performance evidence.
Explicit adverse sensitivity case, not a forecast of automation-driven unemployment or work support efficacy.
Not US dollars, rand, budget estimates, total-cost-of-ownership analysis, or measured cost-effectiveness.

parameter_registry.unit: unvalidated index points and basis-point proxies
parameter_registry.limitation: Not privacy valuations, inequality measurements, fairness scores, or a single policy-ranking objective.
